# Error-code catalogue

Source: `schema/error-codes.json`. File and application codes are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and shown to the Facilitator. Protocol codes are lower_snake_case and returned to participant pages. Each code has a message key in the language resource files.

## File codes (Facilitator-facing)

| Code | HTTP | Retry | Alerts Facilitator | Stage | Meaning | Acceptance scenarios |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FILE_NOT_FOUND | - | user_action | no | 1 | The file no longer exists at the remembered or typed path. | AT-FILE-026 |
| FILE_UNREADABLE | - | user_action | no | 1 | The file exists but cannot be read (input/output error). | AT-FILE-027 |
| FILE_PERMISSION_DENIED | - | user_action | no | 1 | The operating system denies reading the file or writing to its folder. | AT-FILE-003, AT-FILE-028 |
| FILE_INVALID_CONTAINER | - | never | no | 1 | The archive structure is invalid or unsafe (see rules VAL-C-001 to VAL-C-009). | AT-FILE-007, AT-FILE-008, AT-FILE-023, AT-FILE-024 |
| FILE_INVALID_MANIFEST | - | never | no | 1 | manifest.json is invalid or inconsistent (see rules VAL-M-* and VAL-X-004). | AT-FILE-009, AT-FILE-010, AT-FILE-018, AT-FILE-019 |
| FILE_INVALID_CONTENT | - | never | no | 1 | A slide, theme or settings file is invalid, missing or orphaned. | AT-FILE-011, AT-FILE-022 |
| FILE_INVALID_MEDIA | - | never | no | 1 | A media file does not match its declared size, hash or type. | AT-FILE-012, AT-FILE-020 |
| FILE_INVALID_DATABASE | - | never | no | 1 | data.db fails defensive validation or an integrity check. | AT-FILE-013, AT-FILE-025 |
| FILE_TOO_LARGE | - | never | no | 1 | The file or its contents exceed a size limit. | AT-FILE-017 |
| FILE_UNSUPPORTED_NEWER | - | user_action | no | 1 | The file was created by a newer version of the application and is refused. | AT-FILE-005 |
| FILE_OPEN_READ_ONLY_UNKNOWN_TYPE | - | user_action | no | 1 | The file contains slide types this version does not know; it opens read-only and cannot be saved over. | AT-FILE-006 |
| FILE_LOCKED | - | user_action | no | 1 | The file is locked by another application instance (or an unreadable lock exists). | AT-LOCK-001, AT-LOCK-002, AT-LOCK-003 |
| FILE_LOCK_LOST | - | user_action | no | 1 | The lock file is missing or no longer ours at save time; the save is refused. | AT-LOCK-007 |
| FILE_TARGET_CHANGED | - | user_action | no | 1 | The target file was replaced or changed outside the application; the save is refused. | AT-LOCK-008 |
| FILE_SAVE_DISK_FULL | - | user_action | no | 1 | There is not enough free space to write the file; nothing was changed. | AT-FILE-002 |
| FILE_SAVE_FAILED | - | user_action | no | 1 | Saving failed for another reason; the original is intact. | AT-FILE-004 |
| FILE_SAVE_VERIFY_FAILED | - | user_action | no | 1 | The newly written package failed re-validation and was not installed. | AT-FILE-021 |
| FILE_RECOVERY_AVAILABLE | - | user_action | no | 1 | A leftover working directory was found; Recover or Discard is offered. | AT-REC-001, AT-REC-002 |
| FILE_CORRUPTED_RESTORE_AVAILABLE | - | user_action | no | 1 | The file is damaged and a backup can be restored. | AT-FILE-014 |
| FILE_PASSWORD_OR_DAMAGED | - | user_action | no | 7 | A protected file could not be opened: the password may be wrong or the file damaged (one message for both). | AT-PROT-001 |

## Application codes (Facilitator-facing)

| Code | HTTP | Retry | Alerts Facilitator | Stage | Meaning | Acceptance scenarios |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MIGRATION_FAILED | - | never | no | 1 | A migration failed and was rolled back; nothing changed. | AT-MIGR-001 |
| APP_TEST_MODE_NEEDS_DATA_DIR | - | never | no | 1 | In test mode the application refuses to start without an explicit data directory. | AT-ISO-001 |
| SLIDE_INCOMPLETE | - | user_action | no | 2 | A slide cannot be previewed or presented until its mandatory fields are filled. | AT-SLIDE-001 |
| NET_BIND_FAILED | - | user_action | yes | 2 | The participant server could not start on the chosen interface; there is no fallback. | AT-PRES-003 |
| NET_NO_INTERFACE | - | user_action | yes | 2 | No usable network interface was found. | AT-PRES-008 |
| NET_INTERFACE_CHANGED | - | user_action | yes | 3 | The chosen interface changed or disappeared while Live. | AT-NET-004 |
| SLIDE_LOCKED_BY_RESPONSES | - | user_action | no | 3 | Content edits are locked because the slide has stored responses. | AT-DATA-001 |

## Protocol codes (participant-facing)

| Code | HTTP | Retry | Alerts Facilitator | Stage | Meaning | Acceptance scenarios |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| already_answered | 200 | never | no | 2 | The participant already has a response and the rule allows only one. | AT-RESP-003, AT-RECON-001 |
| closed | 200 | never | no | 2 | The slide has closed (including after any grace period). | AT-RESP-005 |
| not_accepting | 200 | user_action | no | 2 | The Facilitator switched Accepting responses off. | AT-RESP-006 |
| not_current | 200 | never | no | 2 | The submission is for a slide that is not current and not within its grace period. | AT-RESP-010 |
| not_live | 200 | never | no | 2 | The Presentation is not Live. | AT-RESP-011 |
| invalid | 200 | never | no | 2 | The envelope is well formed but the payload fails the slide's response schema. | AT-RESP-008 |
| bad_request | 400 | never | no | 2 | The request is malformed or contains unknown fields. | AT-RESP-012 |
| too_large | 413 | never | no | 2 | The request exceeds the size limit. | AT-RESP-007 |
| rate_limited | 429 | after_delay | no | 2 | Too many requests from this participant or address. | AT-RESP-009, AT-JOIN-007 |
| activity_full | 200 | after_delay | no | 2 | The participant limit has been reached. | AT-JOIN-004, AT-JOIN-005 |
| storage_error | 503 | after_delay | yes | 2 | The response could not be stored; nothing was acknowledged. | AT-RESP-013 |
| id_conflict | 200 | never | no | 2 | The submission ID was already used for a different payload. | AT-RESP-004 |
| unauthorized | 401 | after_reconnect | no | 2 | The participant token is missing, unknown or expired; the page rejoins. | AT-JOIN-008, AT-RECON-007 |
| join_code_invalid | 200 | user_action | no | 2 | The join code is wrong or expired. | AT-JOIN-002 |
| protocol_mismatch | 400 | user_action | no | 2 | The page and the application speak different protocol versions; refresh the page. | AT-JOIN-006 |
| server_busy | 503 | after_delay | no | 2 | The server is shedding load; retry after a short random delay. | AT-RECON-003 |
| removed | 403 | never | no | 4 | The Facilitator removed this participant. | AT-IDEN-004 |
| id_in_use | 200 | user_action | yes | 5 | A roster ID is already logged in on another device. | AT-AUTH-002 |
| credentials_invalid | 200 | user_action | no | 5 | ID or PIN not recognised (same message for known and unknown IDs). | AT-AUTH-001 |
| locked_out | 200 | after_delay | yes | 5 | Too many failed attempts; try again later. | AT-AUTH-003 |
